# PubMed

> > PubMed is the free search interface to 40+ million biomedical citations from MEDLINE, journals, and books, providing access to life science literature and clinical evidence.

PubMed is maintained by the National Library of Medicine (NLM) and National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI), part of the National Institutes of Health. It offers advanced search capabilities, citation management, clinical query tools, and programmatic access via E-utilities API for researchers, clinicians, and the general public.

## Key Topics

- MEDLINE

## Core Search & Discovery

- [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov): PubMed homepage: 40M+ biomedical citations from MEDLINE, journals, books
- [Advanced Search Results - PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/advanced): Advanced search builder with filters, saved searches, and query alerts
- [Clinical Queries - PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/clinical): Specialized search tool for clinical studies and evidence retrieval
- [Single Citation Matcher - PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/citmatch): Tool to find articles by citation details or PMID lookup
- [Batch Citation Matcher - PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/batchcitmatch): Bulk citation lookup tool with file upload and PMID retrieval

## Citation Management & Tools

- [Clipboard - PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/clipboard): Citation management tool supporting AMA, APA, MLA formatting

## Data Access & APIs

- [Download Data - PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/download): Data download, FTP access, E-utilities API, XML format documentation

## Documentation & Support

- [Help - PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/help): Search tutorials, FAQ, syntax guides, citation management documentation
- [About - PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/about): Overview of PubMed, NCBI, NLM, NIH, and database components

## Featured Clinical Research

- [2026 ACC/AHA/AACVPR/ABC/ACPM/ADA/AGS/APhA/ASPC/NLA/PCNA Guideline on the Management of Dyslipidemia](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41824552): 2026 clinical practice guideline on dyslipidemia management and cholesterol
- [2026 ACC/AHA Guideline on the Management of Dyslipidemia](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41824590): Clinical guideline on dyslipidemia, statin therapy, and lipid disorders
- [Bleeding Risk with Apixaban vs. Rivaroxaban in Acute Venous Thromboembolism](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41812192): RCT comparing bleeding risk between apixaban and rivaroxaban
- [CRLF1 Secreted by Cardiac Fibroblasts Promotes Human Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41838796): Research on CRLF1 signaling in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy pathogenesis
- [Senescence-associated metabolic alterations aggravate calcific aortic valve disease](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41841768): Study on NAD+ metabolism and inflammaging in aortic valve disease
